name: B10-0352/2026 (ESN) – Ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the killing of at least 23 Christians, including a pastor, in Kawel village in Nigeria on 21 June 2026. It says this attack is part of a wider pattern of Islamist violence against Christian communities. It calls on Nigeria to protect its citizens, investigate and prosecute attackers, and fight corruption. It also asks the European Union to support Nigeria's security forces. The text is a statement of concern and a set of requests; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects the Nigerian government, which is urged to act, and Christian communities in Nigeria.
- Next, the text is sent to the European Union institutions and to Nigeria's government and parliament.
